name: breathtaking-floors
description: A pixel-art roguelite: survivors-style hordes, twin-stick guns, light as territory and elemental reactions. Runs in the browser (Yandex Games, YouTube Playables).

scripts.build: npm run bake && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:yandex: npm run bake && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode yandex && node tools/zip.mjs dist-yandex
scripts.build:youtube: npm run bake && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode youtube && node tools/zip.mjs dist-youtube
scripts.build:single: npm run bake && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode single && node tools/single.mjs
